notes.title: Stirring Abyss Changelog v1.06.01
notes.content:
Stirring Abyss Changelog v1.06.01

An update has crawled forth from the darkness... check out the details in the patch notes below:


General:

-The individual difficulty of an Endless mission is now indicated in its tooltip on the Map. Previously this was only indicated by the graphic of the mission node on the Map. (Note: The individual mission difficulty is independent from the overall difficulty of the game you select from the Menu before starting the game.)
-Improved the scaling of some sprites on high resolutions.


Balance:

-Missions on the first Map of a new Endless game can no longer spawn as the hardest individual difficulty. (Note: This change will not apply to Endless games started before this patch.)
-Enemy health has been adjusted to be lower on the first few Maps of a new Endless game. (Note: If you have an active Endless game from a previous patch, this change will take effect from your next mission onwards.)
-Salvage missions on the Endless mode have slightly longer timers on normal and hard difficulty missions. (Note: If you have an active Endless game from a previous patch, this change will take effect from your next mission onwards.)


Bugfixes:

-Fixed a bug where the Black Blood scourge would apply its full effect on enemy Ascendants, instead of a reduced effect like intended.
-Fixed a bug where the Black Blood scourge would not reset properly.

notes.title: Major Update - Harvester Patch (update 1.06)
notes.content:
A [b]major update[/b] for Stirring Abyss is now available, introducing a new enemy type and new maps. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1178210/discussions/0/3113647550044148800/]Check out the full changelog.[/url]

[h3]MEET THE HARVESTER[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/9c700afabc1106dbeae5a3800ec6dddf64948380.jpg[/img]

It approaches in silence, lurking in the twilight zone where the electric glow of their lamps is drowned out by the eternal darkness of the deep ocean. Pupils dilate, the hair on their arms stands on edge, a cold sweat forms. The Harvester is near, and the fields are ripe with frightened minds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/f92843040a7768ab4dda35cd4e5c79cc1eca5d1a.png[/img]

The Harvester is a creature of nightmare that [b]feeds upon the Sanity of your crew[/b] and grows more dangerous the more it consumes. These otherworldly monstrosities stalk the deep trenches and ruins of the Abyss, ready to reap their unwilling harvest. Harvesters can be encountered in both Story and Endless mode, and will spawn in campaigns started before the patch as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/be3a3a1d24b0a76123f9bd9c411fe3133de0c976.png[/img]

[h3]NEW MAPS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/8f351c8c40c620713c526f27590ca80ff2f89204.png[/img]

For those players who have already thoroughly explored the Abyss, we are adding a couple of new maps for bonus missions - one new Seal Defense mission set on a rooftop plaza of ancient Akoratya, and one new Diver Rescue mission that sends you delving into the depths of the abyssal trench.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37902140/90029e931430b534c99999adf6fccf4b07585343.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178210/Stirring_Abyss/

notes.title: Stirring Abyss - v1.05
notes.content:
A new patch for Stirring Abyss is now available, including French localisation and other fixes.

[b]General:[/b]

- French localisation now available!
- You can now rename your divers. (Look for the small icon of a pen on the personnel sheet)
- Easy is now the default difficulty when starting the game for the first time.

[b]Balance:[/b]

- Reduced the crafting costs of most consumable items.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

- Fixed a bug that could cause Salvage and Extermination missions to immediately complete or fail on the first turn of the mission.
- Fixed a bug that could cause the Wards in the "Enemy at the Gates" -mission to become unresponsive upon loading a saved game or following evacuation.
- Fixed the "Continue" text in some story events always displaying in English, regardless of selected language.
- Fixed an erroneous translation for less than maximum divers selected for the Away Team in the Russian localization.

notes.title: Stirring Abyss - v1.03
notes.content:
We've got a few more updates for you to enjoy.

General:

- Updated splash screen (splash screen is also now skippable; default key is ESC)


Balance:

- Increased the effectiveness of the 'extended rest' function on the submarine (it now receives a bonus of 10 healing on top of the normal rest healing)


Bugfixes:

- Fixed some additional rare issues with saving and loading
- Fixed a rare bug in the last level that could cause enemy turn to get stuck
- Fixed a bug that could cause the buttons in the gameover screen to not function
- Fixed translated text issues with deployed Air Tanks
- Fixed a bug that could leave a ghost diver in the mission "Sinking Reality"

As ever, thanks for playing!

notes.title: Stirring Abyss - v1.01.00
notes.content:
We've released the first patch for Stirring Abyss.

[b]General changes[/b]
• Added an option in the graphics settings to disable the water screen effects
• Increased the scroll sensitivity of the settings menu ingame
• Increased the size of USS Salems inventory

[b]Balance[/b]
• Reunions mission (third level):
- Slightly reduced the amount of enemies

• The Hand That Guides (fourth level):
- Conduits have 2 less armor
- Slightly reduced the amount of enemies
- Made the ending event slightly easier on all difficulties

• Decreased Sanity loss from Corruption Level increasing when its already full

• Decreased maximum Sanity penalty after insanity episodes and resurrection (-1 on all difficulties)

• Significantly decreased Sanity cost of Dark Bargain to bring it more in line with other upgrades (from 12 to 4)

• Friendly fire between Divers can no longer be a critical hit

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
• Fixed a bug that made it impossible to complete some missions after loading the mission from a save
• Fixed a bug that could result in regenerated Power being lost when loading specific auto saves
• Fixed a bug that caused Esc/Back button to not work on the submarine screen in certain
conditions
• Fixed an issue in the mission "Dissension" that could cause divers to become stuck walking in place
• Fixed a stability issue related to spawning random Soviet logs into missions
• Fixed a bug with the Chainshot speargun that could cause it to accidentally hit secondary targets more often than intended
• Fixed a visual bug that caused the pause menu difficulty indicator to temporarily display the wrong value if you loaded the game from the menu onto the submarine
• Fixed a visual bug that caused saves created on the Salem to always show up as Normal difficulty in the Load menu
• Fixed a visual bug with the version number display ingame
• Fixed a visual bug where level map close button would get left behind another image in the late game
• Fixed an issue with Weapons Specialist that could create a phantom Weapons Specialist projectile in the scene
• Fixed an issue with loading save information when the system Time Zone is not properly set.
• Fixed an issue where the names of rescued Divers were missing from story event text.
• Fixed some issues with translated texts
• Macabre Gluttony can now be targeted on a corpse youre standing on
• Fixed a few other minor bugs
